results.name: The Fan Maker - DAE Villages
results.description:
This is my take on the DAE Villages assignment for our game art course.
The assignment was to create a cozy stylized scene based on an ancient civilization, and to give the person living there an easily recognizable occupation.

I chose ancient China and went with a traditional fan maker, who sells their fans in the front of the house and has a little workshop area in the back.



Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BkkMFbSlFYc

results.name: Black Myth: Wukong - Er Lang Shen [Static]
results.description:
Er Lang Shen - Introduction

There is a magical fish in the South China Sea that can change into black and white. When it appears, it brings storms and plague. A fisherman helped an old man carrying a scroll across the river. The old man read the fortune for the fisherman and warned him not to let a young man wearing a bamboo hat and a white robe enter the fishing village. A few days later, the fisherman met the man but sent him to a neighboring village. After the man left, a big black fish appeared in the river, causing a storm. After a while, a big plague broke out in the neighboring village, killing many people. He was a little complacent, but the plague still spread and their village was not spared.

results.name: Black Myth: Wukong - Hao Fu Li Shi [Static]
results.description:
Hao Fu Li Shi - Introduction

The Niu Mo Wang (see my render) watched the bull demons training in the camp of Chunqiu Village. He appreciated the training results of Hao Fu Li Shi and promoted him to the position of Vanguard. Hao Fu Li Shi thanked the Niu Mo Wang for the promotion and promised to be loyal to him. At this time, the Niu Mo Wang's son, a red-skinned boy, came to the camp. The Niu Mo Wang asked him to learn how to select soldiers and introduce the newly appointed Vanguard to him. The boy said that he would make Hao Fu Li Shi his general in the future. The boy asked to keep something, but the Niu Mo Wang refused and looked a little haggard. Although the boy was puzzled, he respected his father's decision and left the camp.
